annotations.title: Read a vote's counts (hosts and organizers only)

description: Reads a vote's counts per option, total ballots and whether it is open or closed. For a rating vote: each entry's average to one decimal, its count and whether it placed, and the winner. For a ranking vote: each entry's points, firsts and place, and the winner. Hosts and organizers only. Never says who voted for what.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

voteId.description: The vote; the latest when absent.
